deathSays.line: 📖 LEARNED: Ritual & Meaning (Level 1). Marking the dead matters. Even without religion, ritual holds grief.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Henry Cao. Tattoo artist. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Trail compass, Dispatcher's headset, Dead Phone, Home key, Tasting Spoon. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. They found a deer this morning. Inside out. Not eaten — unmade. Like something was trying to understand how it worked. It didn't finish.

◈ FLASHBACK — Trail compass
